title: Expression Evaluation
definition: Expression evaluation applies language-defined operator and conversion rules to produce a value or effect.
purpose: Enable deterministic prediction and trace of compound expressions.
history: Operational semantics distinguish the structure of an expression from the runtime order and effects of evaluating it.
mental_model: Reduce an expression tree from leaves to intermediate typed values until one result remains, recording effects separately.
analogy: A recipe combines prepared ingredients in an order; the analogy fails because operands may be evaluated left-to-right even when operators group differently.
common_mistakes: Jumping directly to a final result
Confusing grouping with operand evaluation order
industry_notes: Named intermediate values can trade concision for observability and reviewability.
ai_notes: Require AI to provide an evaluator table, not only a claimed final value.
interview_notes: Ask for a stepwise evaluation with types and conversion rules.
exercise_candidates: Trace compound expressions into intermediate values
